method: For each of the 14,510 frozen FINAL-1.2 process states, maximize strict-scaling TOF over the canonical 0.005-eV E_N grid. At fixed state, metal inventory, reactor volume and vessel cost are monotone in required active metal / bed volume, so the E_N that maximizes TOF is also the cost-minimizing E_N for every lifetime/recovery value. The global lifecycle boundary is then the lower envelope over all states.
interpretation: The direct activity-only target is unreachable. Allowing lifetime and recovery to improve jointly moves the economic target much closer to the strict scaling manifold, and the preregistered lifecycle box (life <= 20 y, recovery <= 0.99) intersects it. The best tested corner (20 y, 99% recovery) is below Fe by 0.3167 USD/t NH3 (2.75%). Parity is reached inside the box, e.g. at 20 y with 98.3498% recovery or at 99% recovery with 12.12 y lifetime.
